_about: The demo's dumb AI (scripts/sim/ai_dumb.gd): fly straight at cruise speed; when within a margin of the map edge, turn toward the map centre. That is the whole behaviour (exit criterion 2: 'the AI may be as dumb as it likes, but it flies on its own'). The design doc's real Enemy AI (patrol, engage, disengage; component 14) replaces it. PROPOSED by Track S, 2026-10-09.

edge_margin_turn_radii._reason: turning back from an edge met head-on needs one turn radius of forward room; half a radius more covers the speed the turn has not yet bled off. In radii, not metres, so a bomber's wide turn gets a wide margin
